name: Trade-Secret Grade Confidentiality
text: The Parties acknowledge that the Confidential Information includes trade secrets, the unauthorised use or disclosure of which would cause irreparable harm to the Disclosing Party. The Receiving Party shall treat such trade secrets with the highest degree of protection and shall: (a) store all trade-secret information in secure, access-controlled systems with encryption where stored or transmitted electronically; (b) limit disclosure strictly to identified individuals bound by written confidentiality obligations and on a documented need-to-know basis; (c) not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or attempt to derive the underlying know-how, formulae, processes, or methods embodied in the trade secrets; and (d) not retain any copies, extracts, or derivatives beyond the period strictly necessary for the Purpose. The confidentiality obligations in respect of trade secrets shall subsist for so long as the relevant information retains the character of a trade secret and is not lawfully in the public domain, notwithstanding the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

legal_basis.note: Protection of trade secrets through confidentiality is an enforceable exception to restraint of trade
Reasonable security practices and procedures for sensitive information
Compensation for loss caused by breach including misuse of trade secrets

invalid_if: Information is lawfully in the public domain
No reasonable security measures are maintained by the Receiving Party
title: Confidentiality Obligation
